correctness.rationale: The six stated shifts are the expansion of (xy)⁻¹(1+x)(1+y)(1+xy) in characteristic two. In the Chinese-remainder local factors K[u,v]/(u^k,v^ell), the unit factors are all but the union of the two axes and the inverse-root diagonal, with r+s+g−2 excluded. The stable image has the claimed dimension; all its phase preimages under F^T have the same size by rank-nullity. On the two noncentral axes the nilpotency indices are k and ell; on the noncentral inverse-root diagonal the change v→v(1+u) gives u+v of index max(k,ell), by Frobenius and a nonzero extreme monomial one step earlier. Centrally uv(u+v+uv) is killed at the smaller truncation when k≠ell, and just before that the extreme monomial with exponent 2min(k,ell)−2 in the larger variable survives. When k=ell=2h, its h-th power is zero and the extreme term u^(2h−2)v^(h−1) survives at h−1. The frozen proof skips the local k=ell=2 case, which can occur with odd parts >1: the multiplier is then already zero by u²=v²=0, so its index is one and it does not change the global maximum. This completes the transient law and, since (r−1)(s−1)>g−1 when r,s>1, the extinction criterion. On the dyadic square, factoring u^(h−1)v^(h−1) reduces the rank calculation to multiplication by z^(h−1) in the quotient with u^(h+1)=(u+z)^(h+1)=0. After imposing z^(h−1)=0 only the additional monomial constraint u^h z=0 survives, giving quotient dimension h²−h+1 and image rank 3h. In the rectangle the penultimate multiplier differs from u^(m−1)v^(2m−2) by a unit, giving rank n−2m+2. Independent power-rank stabilization confirms all regimes, e.g. 8×8 ranks 64,42,24,12,0; 4×8 ranks 32,18,8,2,0; 6×6 ranks 36,20,8,8; 9×12 ranks 108,86,76,66,56,56.
residual_risks: The recorded count of 102,912 full trajectories is for four of the seven test_direct sizes (the other three get basis-action comparisons only). These finite tests neither prove the theorem nor certify every trajectory at those larger sizes.

evidence: For a power of two a≥max(k,ell), F^a is the sum of the original shifts multiplied by a. It is the direct sum of k ell copies of the operator on odd r×s periods, where reduction to a circumference of one yields zero, and otherwise the existing rank formula gives rs−r−s−g+2. Ranks of F^a and F^(2a) are equal by the same shift-group argument, so the image is stable. This already implies d and the extinction criterion; equal-sized phase fibres then follow by rank-nullity.

That argument only fixes ranks at certain powers of two; it does not recover rank F^(h−1) on a 2h×2h square or F^(m−1) on a dyadic rectangle. Sharp local vanishing/nonvanishing and the non-power penultimate ranks need the additional ideal computation.

value.rationale: For this natural six-neighbor toroidal rule, the sharp nilpotent depth says exactly when transient information has been lost, not just whether the matrix is singular or how many states remain. The precise fraction of states still surviving at the penultimate update distinguishes dyadic squares from rectangles of equal short side and is a useful exact observable not obtained from the one-step rank. The depth and last-step laws give value even after crediting the already implied stable dimension.
residual_risks: The result does not give a full intermediate transient distribution or primitive-cycle census.
